newsitem.title: USA: Transmix plant planned for Calif. pipeline by 1998.
newsitem.headline: Transmix plant planned for Calif. pipeline by 1998.

text.p: Northridge Petroleum Marketing U.S. Inc said Monday it will build a 4,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) processor along the refined products pipeline from Los Angeles to Arizona by 1998.
The plant will make finished petroleum products from transmix, a mixture of gasoline and distillate that results from pipeline and storage operations, the company said.
Northridge, a unit of TransCanada Energy USA, Inc, will finance the $8.5 million-project through a joint venture with pipeline operator Santa Fe Pacific Partners, L.P. (SFPP).
Northridge will contribute $4.25 million for the project, while SFPP will provide its current pipeline assets plus $1.75 million.
SFPP will also build and operate the plant, to be located in Colton, Calif., while Northridge plans to market the products.
ARCO Products Co and Chevron USA Products have entered term agreements to process some products at the proposed plant.
